Name: Cozy Coastal Cottage - Ginger Island Farmhouse Redesign
Author: craseydreams29
Description:
[size=3]This is my take on a Ginger Island vacation home that offers all the bare necessities in a warm and inviting way. I wanted the vibe of a shore house that you only stay at a couple times per year, where you plan on being out and about on the island most of the time, anyway, but which will still keep you comfy and cozy on a rainy day. Mornings where you squeeze past each other in a cramped kitchen. A place meant for being cluttered with mementos and memories.

[u][b]Features:[/b]
[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]a welcoming little entryway! (instead of walking smack-dab into the kitchen when you enter the farmhouse, now you have a place to brush the sand off your sandals)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]a kitchenette with a dining table nook! (designed with space for a PIF door to lead to a backyard or patio - cos when I think beach, I also think grill)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]two bedrooms! (I've styled mine as a main bedroom and an office for my currently single farmer, but once I get married in-game, I plan to turn that into a room for the kids)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
IF there's any interest in a farmhouse without an already built kitchen, I [i]might[/i] upload an alternate version, but I otherwise don't plan on making any changes to the layout. Because the warp points for the Ginger Island farmhouse are hard-coded (I think? If there is actually a way to change them, please tell me), I did have to make some concessions to my original vision (RIP to my plans for a third room in the second floor hallway that would've functioned as a bathroom), but PIF honestly handles all my additional room desires so easily and so seamlessly, it's a much better solution than anything I could make.

Ultimately, I'm super happy with how this turned out, and it suits my playthrough needs perfectly. If you're looking for something more spacious, this is probably not the mod for you! I think this probably has less space than the vanilla map? But it's structured, and it's symmetrical, and that's the only way I can get my brain to figure out how to decorate an interior.

So... will you be coming to the cottage?

[b][u]Compatibility & Bugs:[/u][/b]

As I used vanilla tilesheets, this should be compatible with any and all recolors.

An Android compatible version of the mod is available in the optional downloads section! Please download that file if you play on Android. 

Obviously, this will be incompatible with any mods that touch the island farmhouse interior, such as other redesigns of the map, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33852?]Empty Kitchen by hadiwrites42[/url]﻿, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27020?]Hallway Fix by KaliRivera[/url], which only work with the vanilla map. Mods that affect the exterior (like a retexture of the island farm sprite or an overhaul of Ginger Island) are fine.

Not sure if this will play well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11037?]Spouses in Ginger Island[/url]﻿ - I anticipate visual glitches at the very least, and maybe pathing issues? And if there are any mods that add cutscenes in the island farmhouse (I don't know of any, but they certainly could exist), I would expect similar visual bugs.

Other than that, there shouldn't be any issues, aside from furniture being misaligned. I think there's a way to edit the starter furniture positions with Content Patcher, which I will try to figure out for a future update, but no promises! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]﻿ will help you with that in the meantime.
